title: Strong and Switchable Magneto-Optical Effect in Air-Stable Chiral DyIII Complexes with Magnetic Anisotropy

synthesis.procedure: Single crystals were obtained by reacting DyCl3·6H2O with R-BINAPO in the presence of H2bbpenMe and NaBPh4. The main article does not provide reagent quantities or a sufficiently detailed preparation procedure.
synthesis.time: Three 10-minute stirring stages, followed by 30 hours of heating; crystals formed after three days of slow evaporation.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Transferred to a sealed vial for heating.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Single crystals were obtained; crystallization details are not given in the main article.

properties.summary: The air-stable complex exhibits strong magnetic anisotropy, slow magnetic relaxation and butterfly-shaped hysteresis up to 12 K. Its room-temperature natural and magnetic circular dichroism reveal DyIII f–f transitions; reversing the applied magnetic field repeatedly switches the CD signal from 700 to 1100 nm.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The DyIII center is eight-coordinate, bound by four N and two O atoms of bbpenMe²⁻ and two O atoms of R-BINAPO in a square-antiprismatic geometry. Phenyl-group π···π interactions with BPh4⁻ link the discrete coordination units into a supramolecular framework.
